items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-08-29
items.q: Especially Ernest Wright who thought the world of me. I was a big name person in New Orleans because he was affiliated with a lot of unions and with churches and so forth and so on. So between Ernest Wright and Jim Russell and Jim Poole who was a big wheel in the Zulus at that particular time.

ctx.x: How'd you get to be Louis' escort?

I don't know, it just, I tell you what happened. By being in radio and working for a newspaper, here I'm a press man. And everybody in the Zulu Club at that time, they knew me. Especially Ernest Wright who thought the world of me. I was a big name person in New Orleans because he was affiliated with a lot of unions and with churches and so forth and so on. So between Ernest Wright and Jim Russell and Jim Poole who was a big wheel in the Zulus at that particular time. God bless him. So that's how I got to become…
Yeah, that was, yeah. That's about all it would have been.

items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: And you had people like Ernest Wright, who started one of the first registration campaigns in the city of New Orleans.

ctx.x: play them and let you listen to them. Yeah, if you want to do that. So, we're on reel number two with Tex Stevens. It's still July the 21st, 1995. July the 1st. Yeah, we're talking about we're talking about, yeah, pro baseball and sports in general. Yeah, and I didn't realize how much

had come out of this area, how much sports. Well, we had a lot of sports and stuff that came out of this area. But then again, you have to thank people like, like, Jack Moore and a few other people, Champ Clark. Then you had people like, Wendy, New Orleans Recreation Department, Jeff was put together. Jeff, Jeff, Jeff, Morris, I think, Jeff was the first black to get involved. Morris, Jeff was a graduate of Zive University and also Chicago University. And he opened many doors for young kids to come out. And they…
Well, what were they going to charge you with? I mean, what could they have?
